reference.title: Implement Claude memory import into the ledger
reference.summary: Built the Claude Code memory import feature end to end for the ox CLI, starting from architecture exploration (how Claude's per-absolute-path memory isolation works, how ledger data/ flows through sync) and ending with 8 new files across internal/memoryimport, internal/claude, internal/gitutil, and cmd/ox. Three user corrections reshaped the design midway: switch source identity from raw paths to SHA-256 fingerprints, track mtime/import per source rather than globally, and TTL-expire stale Conductor workspaces. A test-engineer review flagged P0 missing non-DryRun integration coverage and a P1 path-traversal risk, both addressed. Session also resolved a merge conflict with main and surfaced a separate session-recording bug where ox session stop reported success without writing artifacts.
key_actions: Researched Claude memory system and discovered per-absolute-path (not per-repo) isolation
Created internal/memoryimport with source fingerprinting and per-source tracking
Switched source identity from raw paths to SHA-256 fingerprints after user pushback
Added TTL expiration for stale Conductor workspace entries
Addressed P0 missing non-DryRun integration tests and P1 path-traversal risk from review
Filed a separate bug for ox session stop returning success without writing artifacts
